results.text: Bisoprolol to prevent adverse cardiac events (PACE) in COPD: a multicentre, double-blind, randomised, controlled, phase 3 trial. Although cardiovascular disease is common in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), the efficacy and safety of β blockers in reducing cardiac events and mortality is uncertain.
